activity.notes: Conventional year-level reign window for Omri, founder of the Omride dynasty and builder of Samaria as royal capital. This reviewed Activity is the seed for separating the post-division northern Kingdom of Israel from the earlier Saul-David-Solomon united monarchy that currently shares the Kingdom of Israel identity.
